headline: Full-length isoform profiling and platelet RNA-seq methods resolve transcript diversity
label: Isoform Resolved Transcriptome Tooling
summary: Full-length HiFi sequencing of human left ventricles and purity-aware platelet RNA-seq extend transcriptome annotation to isoforms and low-input cell types.
synthesis: The dominant thread is transcriptome resolution beyond gene-level annotation, with each isoform-focused item pairing a measurement advance with a usable resource. A full-length PacBio HiFi atlas of non-failing, dilated cardiomyopathy and ischemic heart disease human left ventricles reports 15,535 novel isoforms, an augmented GENCODE reference, and the CardioIsoMap portal. Siphon-seq addresses limited RNA input in platelets by overloading barcoded single-cell partitions to increase input, then computationally removing contaminating partitions, yielding a 3,436-gene platelet transcriptome. Its purity-aware design is the new element. Adjacent items, including ScarX for conserved organ-resolved fibrosis signals in bulk RNA-seq and the culture-associated cardiac fibroblast surfaceome with CFxplorer, are interactive or proteomic resources that are not isoform-focused and are included only as context.
